description: This file defines a React component called FavoritesPage that displays a list of favorited recipes. It imports React, a custom hook useFavorites from context, and a RecipeCard component. The component retrieves favorite recipe IDs from context, generates placeholder recipe objects if there are no backend details, and renders these recipes in a grid layout.

methods.name: FavoritesPage()
methods.description: React functional component that displays user's favorite recipes.
